map.输入买入、卖出价格与股数，考虑佣金与税费后计算真实盈亏: Enter the buy and sell prices and the number of shares to compute the true profit or loss after commissions and taxes
map.📖 查看「股票盈亏计算 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Stock Profit and Loss Calculator User Guide"
map.净盈亏 = 卖出额 − 买入额 − 买入佣金 − 卖出佣金 − 印花税 − 过户: Net P&L = sell proceeds − buy cost − buy commission − sell commission − stamp duty − transfer fee; commission = max(turnover × commission rate, minimum commission); stamp duty = sell proceeds × rate (sell side only)
map.买入额 = 买入价×股数、卖出额 = 卖出价×股数；佣金按成交额比例收取且不低于: Buy cost = buy price × shares and sell proceeds = sell price × shares; commission is charged as a proportion of turnover and is never below the minimum commission; stamp duty is levied on the sell side only, and the transfer fee is charged on both sides as a proportion of turnover.
map.买入佣金 = max(买入金额 × 佣金费率, 最低佣金): Buy commission = max(buy amount × commission rate, minimum commission)
map.卖出印花税 = 卖出金额 × 印花税率（A股仅卖出时收取）: Sell stamp duty = sell amount × stamp duty rate (charged on the sell side only for A-shares)
map.过户费 = 成交金额 × 过户费率（沪市收取，深市部分券商免收，此处默认计入）: Transfer fee = turnover × transfer fee rate (charged by the Shanghai exchange; waived by some brokers in Shenzhen; included here by default)
map.净盈亏 = 卖出净收入 - 买入总成本: Net P&L = net sell proceeds − total buy cost
map.计算结果仅供参考，实际费用以券商交割单为准: Results are for reference only; actual fees are subject to the broker's settlement statement

map.买入额=10000 元。佣金率 0.025%（最低 5 元）→ 佣 5 元；印花: Buy amount = 10,000 CNY. Commission rate 0.025% (minimum 5 CNY) → 5 CNY; stamp duty is charged only on the sell side at 0.05% → 5 CNY (estimated on a sale of 10,000); transfer fee 0.001% on both sides ≈ 0.2 CNY. Break-even price ≈ (10000+5+5+0.2)/1000 ≈ 10.02 CNY, i.e. a gain of about 0.2% to recover costs.
map.降低佣金率影响: The effect of a lower commission rate
map.若佣金率 0.015%（最低 5 元仍 5 元），小单成本主要由最低佣金决定；大: With a commission rate of 0.015% (still 5 CNY because of the minimum), the cost of a small order is driven mainly by the minimum commission; for a large order (say 100,000 CNY) the commission is 15 CNY and the effect on the break-even price is clearer.
map.印花税现在怎么收？: How is stamp duty charged now?
map.A股卖出时收成交额的 0.05%（2023 年减半后），买入不收；过户费沪深均约: For A-shares, 0.05% of turnover is charged on the sell side (after the 2023 halving) and nothing on the buy side; the transfer fee is about 0.001% on both sides in both Shanghai and Shenzhen.
map.最低佣金 5 元怎么处理？: How is the 5 CNY minimum commission handled?
map.单笔佣金不足 5 元按 5 元收，小额交易实际费率远高于名义费率，保本点主要由最: If a single trade's commission is under 5 CNY it is charged at 5 CNY, so the effective rate on small trades is far above the nominal rate and the break-even point is raised mainly by the minimum commission.
